avalanche.note: 1-1: A snow-white mountain fortress coming down like an avalanche, twin cannons on its slopes.
avalanche.name: AVALANCHE

frostjaw.note: 1-2: An icebreaker with a jagged frozen jaw, missile racks along its flanks.
frostjaw.name: FROSTJAW

iron_summit.note: 1-3: An iron peak of stacked decks: turrets, cannons and two reactors at its summit.
iron_summit.name: IRON SUMMIT

stormpeak.note: 1-4: A storm-wreathed spire ship crackling with beam emitters.
stormpeak.name: STORMPEAK

ridgebreaker.note: 1-5: A broad mining crawler with a ridge-splitting prow and a field of flak guns.
ridgebreaker.name: RIDGEBREAKER

highlord.note: 1-6: The Highlands' warlord: a crowned flagship with heavy cannons and flak towers.
highlord.name: HIGHLORD

ironbark.note: 2-1: A gnarled armored hulk like an iron-barked tree, reactors at its roots, missile racks in its branches.
ironbark.name: IRONBARK

thornback.note: 2-2: A spiny cruiser whose back bristles with flak guns like thorns.
thornback.name: THORNBACK

rootmaw.note: 2-3: A very wide ship spreading like roots around a gaping maw, turrets all over.
rootmaw.name: ROOTMAW

wildfire.note: 2-4: A blazing raider wing packed with missile racks.
wildfire.name: WILDFIRE

grovekeeper.note: 2-5: A tall guardian ship standing in a grove of flak towers.
grovekeeper.name: GROVEKEEPER

old_growth.note: 2-6: An ancient, moss-dark battleship with beam emitters and radar dishes.
old_growth.name: OLD GROWTH

bogmaw.note: 3-1: A squat swamp hulk with a wide maw, missile racks and radars.
bogmaw.name: BOGMAW

mirelord.note: 3-2: A huge, wide marsh barge, its deck a field of flak guns.
mirelord.name: MIRELORD

fenwraith.note: 3-3: A pale, ghostly ship drifting low, flak guns around two reactors.
fenwraith.name: FENWRAITH

hydra.note: 3-4: A many-headed warship: cannon, missile and flak heads on long necks.
hydra.name: HYDRA

marsh_titan.note: 3-5: A colossal swamp titan, wider than half the screen, studded with radar dishes.
marsh_titan.name: MARSH TITAN

drowned_king.note: 3-6: A barnacled royal flagship risen from the river, radar dishes and two gatlings.
drowned_king.name: DROWNED KING

scarecrow.note: 4-1: A gaunt cross-shaped ship with ragged wings, reactors glowing like eyes.
scarecrow.name: SCARECROW

combine.note: 4-2: A giant harvesting combine with a wide reaper bar and reactors along its body.
combine.name: COMBINE

locust.note: 4-3: A swarm mother with long locust wings, reactors, missile racks and radars.
locust.name: LOCUST

granary.note: 4-4: A flying grain silo complex with radars, beam emitters and reactors.
granary.name: GRANARY

harrowmaster.note: 4-5: A wide harrow ship dragging its tines, turrets on its frame and a big cannon.
harrowmaster.name: HARROWMASTER

black_harvest.note: 4-6: A black reaper ship with a long scythe wing and rows of reactors.
black_harvest.name: BLACK HARVEST

maelstrom.note: 5-1: A whirling vortex ship ringed with gatlings and reactors.
maelstrom.name: MAELSTROM

man_o_war.note: 5-2: A jellyfish-like warship trailing beam emitters and cannons like stinging tentacles.
man_o_war.name: MAN O' WAR

typhoon.note: 5-3: A wide storm carrier, a wall of cannons along its front.
typhoon.name: TYPHOON

tsunami.note: 5-4: A towering wave-shaped ship, reactors in its crest and gatlings below.
tsunami.name: TSUNAMI

abyssal.note: 5-5: A huge deep-sea leviathan, the biggest of its world, with gatlings and radar dishes.
abyssal.name: ABYSSAL

kraken.note: 5-6: A tall tentacled monster ship, missile racks on its arms.
kraken.name: KRAKEN

mesa.note: 6-1: A flat-topped table mountain of armor, flak guns and cannons on its plateau.
mesa.name: MESA

dust_devil.note: 6-2: A sand-colored ship whirling around a ring of reactors.
dust_devil.name: DUST DEVIL

landslide.note: 6-3: A tumbling slide of armor plates hiding missile racks.
landslide.name: LANDSLIDE

basilisk.note: 6-4: A long serpent-king ship with a crested head, turrets, flak guns and reactors.
basilisk.name: BASILISK

sandworm.note: 6-5: A segmented worm ship rising from the sand, cannons along its rings.
sandworm.name: SANDWORM

monolith.note: 6-6: A tall black slab of a ship, turrets set in its faces.
monolith.name: MONOLITH

furnace.note: 7-1: A huge glowing furnace hulk, the widest boss of the game, lined with cannons.
furnace.name: FURNACE

smokestack.note: 7-2: A factory ship of chimneys and stacks, reactors and cannons between them.
smokestack.name: SMOKESTACK

slag_king.note: 7-3: A molten-armored king of the smelters, crowned with cannons.
slag_king.name: SLAG KING

forgemaster.note: 7-4: An anvil-shaped forge ship, flak towers for hammers.
forgemaster.name: FORGEMASTER

inferno.note: 7-5: A square fire ship of flaming stacks, turrets and cannons.
inferno.name: INFERNO

reactor.note: 7-6: A giant power plant in meltdown, flying: reactors, gatlings and flak guns.
reactor.name: REACTOR

neon_tyrant.note: 8-1: A neon-lit tyrant ship blazing with reactors.
neon_tyrant.name: NEON TYRANT

gridlock.note: 8-2: A flying city block of towers and traffic, missile racks and radars on its roofs.
gridlock.name: GRIDLOCK

blackout.note: 8-3: A huge dark ship that swallows the city lights, ringed with radar dishes.
blackout.name: BLACKOUT

skybreaker.note: 8-4: A skyscraper warship piercing the clouds, reactors and flak guns on its floors.
skybreaker.name: SKYBREAKER

sovereign.note: 8-5: The city's regal flagship, its gold-trimmed hull lined with gatlings and flak guns.
sovereign.name: SOVEREIGN

singularity.note: 8-6: The last boss: a dark core collapsing into itself, turrets orbiting it.
singularity.name: SINGULARITY
